changelogCoverage.item: Added `/powerup` — interactive lessons teaching Claude Code features with animated demos
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` env var to keep the existing marketplace cache when `git pull` fails, useful in offline environments
Fixed an infinite loop where the rate-limit options dialog would repeatedly auto-open after hitting your usage limit, eventually crashing the session
changelogCoverage.evidence: rate-limit options dialog already in tree; official 90 structural hit on usage UI

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed `--resume` causing a full prompt-cache miss on the first request for users with deferred tools, MCP servers, or custom agents (regression since v2.1.69)
changelogCoverage.evidence: resume/deferred-tool cache prefix already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed `Edit`/`Write` failing with "File content has changed" when a PostToolUse format-on-save hook rewrites the file between consecutive edits
changelogCoverage.evidence: astdiff added hDK file_path helper; Edit/Write readFileState already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed `PreToolUse` hooks that emit JSON to stdout and exit with code 2 not correctly blocking the tool call
changelogCoverage.evidence: PreToolUse exit-2 JSON block already in hook runner

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed collapsed search/read summary badge appearing multiple times in fullscreen scrollback when a CLAUDE.md file auto-loads during a tool call
changelogCoverage.evidence: collapsed search/read badge already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed auto mode not respecting explicit user boundaries ("don't push", "wait for X before Y") even when the action would otherwise be allowed
changelogCoverage.evidence: auto mode classifier user-boundary already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed click-to-expand hover text being nearly invisible on light terminal themes
changelogCoverage.evidence: click-to-expand hover theme already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed UI crash when malformed tool input reached the permission dialog
changelogCoverage.evidence: permission dialog malformed-input guard already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Fixed headers disappearing when scrolling `/model`, `/config`, and other selection screens
Hardened PowerShell tool permission checks: fixed trailing `&` background job bypass, `-ErrorAction Break` debugger hang, archive-extraction TOCTOU, and parse-fail fallback deny-rule degradation
changelogCoverage.evidence: astdiff product hits on PowerShellTool; src/tools/PowerShellTool

changelogCoverage.item: Improved performance: eliminated per-turn JSON.stringify of MCP tool schemas on cache-key lookup
changelogCoverage.evidence: MCP schema cache-key already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Improved performance: SSE transport now handles large streamed frames in linear time (was quadratic)
changelogCoverage.evidence: SSE frame handling already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Improved performance: SDK sessions with long conversations no longer slow down quadratically on transcript writes
changelogCoverage.evidence: SDK transcript write already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Improved `/resume` all-projects view to load project sessions in parallel, improving load times for users with many projects
changelogCoverage.evidence: resume all-projects parallel load already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Changed `--resume` picker to no longer show sessions created by `claude -p` or SDK invocations
changelogCoverage.evidence: resume picker filters print/SDK sessions already in tree

changelogCoverage.item: Removed `Get-DnsClientCache` and `ipconfig /displaydns` from auto-allow (DNS cache privacy)
changelogCoverage.evidence: astdiff removed /displaydns; auto-allow list no longer includes those DNS cache commands
